description:
[Trading Data API] Single Kalshi market depth: orderbook (yes/no levels) + recent trades for a specific ticker.

**Example:** `/v1/kalshi-market?ticker=KXBTCD-26JUN1315-T64099.99`

Use when you need one Kalshi market's orderbook and recent trades by ticker. Not for browsing markets by category (use kalshi_probability).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

depth.description: Optional. Orderbook depth per side (default 10, max 100).

ticker.description: Required. A Kalshi market ticker (e.g. KXBTCD-26JUN1315-T64099.99).

trades.description: Optional. Recent trades to return (default 20, max 100).

name: kalshi_market
